Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
The following V:TES events will be held at Dragon*Con
this year:

V:TES Dragon's Breath Tournament.
Session 9&10+ (Saturday, 9am until). $5.00
A standard DCI Constructed Deck Tournament.
WotC-supplied prizes, plus dealer coins, a V:TM T-shirt
and additional prizes based on participation.

V:TES Sealed Sabbat Tournament.
Session 7+ (Friday, 6pm until). $2.00
A Bring-Your-Own Sealed-Deck Game.
Each player provides Six Sabbat Boosters. All the Boosters
collected will then be randomly redistributed to the players
(six each, of course), who will have up to one hour to build
their decks - no trading.
After two rounds of play, the five players with the most
victory points will play in the finals.
Dealer Coins will be used as prizes, with possible additional
prized based on participation.

V:TES Demonstration.
Session 3 (Thursday, 6pm-10pm). $2.00

See http://www.dragoncon.net/dc/gaming/dcadccg.htm for more
information on these and other events at Dragon*Con.
